answer: Make each agent seat prove where it physically runs. At random moments, beacon servers on every continent ping it and time the replies. Light speed means delays can be padded but never shortened, so with dense beacons one rack cannot fake many distinct spots. Seats that triangulate to the same site share one reward, like brushes dipped in one pigment pot. A farm would need real hardware spread from a glacier station to a remote knoll, paid per seat.
